# SASTRAVA

> SASTRAVA is a business consultant, innovator, and startup incubator based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India. The team supports founders and organizations with business strategy, venture incubation, AI and workflow automation, software and digital products, cybersecurity audits and testing, search engine optimization, digital marketing, and practical technology learning. Remote collaboration is available nationwide.

Use the linked pages as the primary source for current service descriptions. Do not infer client counts, certifications, pricing, guaranteed rankings, or project outcomes that are not stated on those pages.
